extDescription.message: Save Tencent CoDesign prototype links and access passwords. Automatically applies credentials when opening shared previews. Paste share text to import in one click.

optionsHeaderDesc.message: Organize CoDesign prototype share links by project and auto-apply access passwords—no more typing them every time.

dragHint.message: Drag to reorder, or move prototypes into / out of projects.

emptyDesc.message: Create a project first, or paste a CoDesign share message to import quickly.

footerNote.message: Data is stored in Chrome sync storage and used only for codesign.qq.com. Nothing is sent to third-party servers.

quickPasteHint.message: Paste a CoDesign share message to auto-fill name, link, and password.

Found $1 prototype(s). Merge with existing data? (Duplicates by link will be overwritten; projects with the same name will be merged)
